levels.surface: أبي محمد بن عمرو بن حريث

notes: «- يعني ابن المديني -» and «- رجل من بني عذرة -» are editor's glosses and are left out
«جده، حريث» is one link: the grandfather written with his name (rule 7), the second occurrence of «حريث» in the text
the Prophet («أبي القاسم») is the end; Sufyan's and Ahmad's remarks after it are not links
